# Maturity Models

> A maturity model is a business tool used to assess people/culture, processes/structures, and objects/technology. This site is a guide to maturity models and a curated set of real-world examples. Source: https://github.com/maturity-models/maturity-models

## Guide

- [Maturity Models](https://maturity-models.github.io/en-us/): what maturity models are, levels, perspectives, FAQ, and rebuttals
